page.layout: One page of running text; marginal notes in the left margin (three notes beside the first paragraphs, plus one small mark beside the second paragraph).

main_text.l: quo vulgò dicunt, quod in corporis humani
structura fit primum vivens & vltimum moriens.
Prædicta fanè factio priùs opprimi non
potuit aut eradicari, quàm Iesuitæ regno exi-
gerentur. Quod fidele & perdurans robur In-
stituto huic in tam variegata hominum colluvie
nil aliud præstat, quàm ea quæ hactenus
de Politiæ forma diximus.
Num verò hæc talia sint, à quibus sibi Resp.
Polona metuere debeat, tibi cogitandum re-
linquo. Ego interim Factionem Iesuiticam in-
ter nos non aliter æstimo, quàm agilem quen-
dam & acutum gladium, cuius lamina quidem
in vaginam Polonicam recondita sit, sed ita, vt
capulum Romana Aula & Hispanus manibus
teneant, & sic eum ad nutum suum vibrent. Id
quod Instituti huius proprius finis aliquando
clarius docebit.
Hic autem & ipse quiddam singulare & ab o-
mnibus aliis Monachorum ordinibus diuer-
sum habet. Omnes enim aliorum Religiosorum
Ordines in hunc finem vt plurimum inuenti
& approbati sunt, & eò tendunt, vt popularis
deuotio per eos augeatur, Religio Romano-
Catholica magis splendeat, & Ordinis spiritua-
lium pomœria dilatentur, &c.
Iesuitæ verò etsi hisce rebus & ipsi pro virili
studeant, sui tamen principalis finis longè sub-
limiorem scopum sibi præfixum habent. Qui
nempe est, Vt Romanæ Ecclesiæ siue Imperii
Ecclesiastici collapsam autoritatem, non solùm recu-

marginalia.note: Iesuitismus cor[?] / Factionis Hispa- / nica in Gallia.

page.notes: Marginal note at top left is partly worn; "Iesuitismus" and "cor" are uncertain, marked [?]. The small mark beside "capulum" is read as "Nb." and is uncertain. The catchword "recu-" is partly cut off at the foot and its hyphen is uncertain. The running head is set in small capitals and has been given in ordinary case. Spelling of u/v was normalised as instructed (viuens to vivens, vltimum to ultimum).
